en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

The more you desire knowledge, 
the quicker it will come.

How about we discuss the qualities of 
goddesses across different mythologies?

They may all be "goddesses," but each 
is a different image of womanhood.

Do you get sleepy in especially 
quiet places, Shuichi?

I won't speak ill of sleepiness itself.
It is a basic human instinct.

But living only by one's instincts will
push one away from knowing culture.

For this reason...it may be advisable 
for you to fight your drowsiness.

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
